SBA & term loans

SBA and term loans for businesses ready to scale

SBA loans are the most respected small business loan program in the country. Government backing lets SBA lenders offer some of the lowest rates and longest terms available. Term loans offer a fixed amount with a set repayment schedule. Both are built for owners with a track record and a plan to grow.

What to say

A talk track that works

Keep it simple and honest. You never need to promise an approval or explain the terms. Our funding team does that.

SBA & term loans talk track

"If you’re planning a big move like a second location or buying your building, there are SBA programs with some of the best rates and longest terms available to small businesses. I can connect you with a team that packages the whole application for you."

Example

A growing dental practice used $90,000 to add an operatory and bring on another hygienist before its appointment calendar was full. The added capacity turned into revenue quickly.

Good to know

SBA loans take longer and require more documentation than other products. For clients who need money this week, our team may suggest a faster option first.

All funding is subject to lender review and approval. Ranges and timelines are typical and can change.
